versions.subject: New Rules
versions.detection:
selection:
    FileName|contains:
        - '\AppData\Local\Microsoft\Credentials\'
        - '\AppData\Roaming\Microsoft\Credentials\'
        - '\AppData\Local\Microsoft\Vault\'
        - '\ProgramData\Microsoft\Vault\'
filter_system_folders:
    Image|startswith:
        - 'C:\Program Files\'
        - 'C:\Program Files (x86)\'
        - 'C:\Windows\system32\'
        - 'C:\Windows\SysWOW64\'
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_*
versions.spl: FileName IN ("*\\AppData\\Local\\Microsoft\\Credentials\\*", "*\\AppData\\Roaming\\Microsoft\\Credentials\\*", "*\\AppData\\Local\\Microsoft\\Vault\\*", "*\\ProgramData\\Microsoft\\Vault\\*") NOT (Image IN ("C:\\Program Files\\*", "C:\\Program Files (x86)\\*", "C:\\Windows\\system32\\*", "C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\*"))
